callback.description:
The air conditioner at {host} opens its own connection back to Home Assistant, so it needs an address and port it can reach on your network, usually the LAN address of the machine running Home Assistant. If Home Assistant runs in a container, use the host machine's LAN address and the port published for Home Assistant. The unit only speaks plain HTTP, so the port must serve Home Assistant without TLS.

Tip: set **Local network** under Settings > System > Network to `http://ADDRESS:PORT` and new units pick it up automatically.

adapter_unresponsive.description:
The {adapter} Wi-Fi adapter of {name} has not answered at {host} for more than 10 minutes. This adapter has been seen to stop answering on the network until the air conditioner was power-cycled.

1. Switch the air conditioner off at the breaker or mains (the remote is not enough), wait 30 seconds and switch it back on.
2. Wait a minute or two for the adapter to rejoin Wi-Fi. Home Assistant reconnects by itself and this message goes away.

If the unit still does not come back, check that its IP address is still {host}. Reserve its address in your router so it does not change, or use **Reconfigure** on the integration entry to enter the new one.
adapter_unresponsive.title: {name} is not responding
